name: Base Converter
description: Convert integers of any size between bases 2–36, with two's complement and an editable bit view
help: Prefixes 0x, 0o and 0b are detected automatically; spaces, underscores and commas are ignored.
Numbers have arbitrary precision; the two's complement table lists every width the value fits in.
Click a bit in the 64-bit view to flip it.
All conversions run in the local Rust engine.
